page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a small diagram in the middle; marginal notes in the left margin beside the second paragraph. Below the diagram, the text continues in one column. Faint show-through from the other side is not transcribed.

main_text.p: men Polybij verbis fiet de interuallis? Vide an non seruare ea possis, imò debeas, legionibus magis plenis. Nam cùm eæ essent quinque millium & ducentorum: palàm est auctum modum in Principum & Hastatorum pedaturâ: ergo & in spatio oppofito, v[?] i Tribuni. Commodè igitur tunc & loces ita, & exigua des interualla. Etiam vt id non fit; verba tamen Polybij & præcepta serues, si in latum tentoria Tribunicia facias pedum modò quadraginta. Nihil impedit, & viæ tunc fuerint mediæ pedum duodenum. Alterum de equitibus, quod obstat: benignè intellegendum fit, opponi eos mediis Tribunorum tentoriis in parte. quod verum esse ex situ vides: & accipe, si vis, tabellam.

PRÆFECTI sociorum, quos Polybius (ô incuriam! necaliter possum dicere, si scriptum hoc integrum) nusquam locat. Præfecti æquantur Tribunis.Nos ad latera Tribunorum ponimus, situ & modulo paribus: quidni? cùm pari munere & dignitate. Vbique eos Polybius æquiparat: nisi quod illi tamen honestiores, quatenus ciues. Ratio etiam vult opponi eos suis Alis siue Cornibus: sicuti legionibus Tribuni. Examina- ta[?] eorum pedatura.Diuidantur ergo, & sint in quaque parte seni, eadem metatura qua Tribuni, nisi quòd viæ aut interualla hic magis exigua, an potius nulla? Cui enim vsui? nec

page.notes: The diagram is a figure: a box labelled PRÆTOR with two rows of six small boxes on either side, each row headed TRIBB. The left-margin note "Examina- ta eorum pedatura" is partly blurred; the middle letters are doubtful. The word "necaliter" is as printed and may be a misprint for "neque aliter". The parenthesis after "(ô incuriam!" is not closed on the page, as printed. The word "v i" in "ut Tribuni" is spaced as printed and read as "vt" with uncertainty.
